achievements.track: Use case 2 · Enterprise Knowledge Copilot — RAG + Agentic Workflow
achievements.summary: Our team, Core I7 from Indium Software, built a secure Enterprise Knowledge Copilot and finished 2nd Runner-up in the Enterprise Knowledge Copilot track.
achievements.problem: Employees lose hours hunting for answers spread across policies, SOPs, project documents and support tickets. Our copilot gives accurate answers with their sources — and only shows each person the information their role allows.
achievements.uniqueIntro: Instead of sending a question straight to an LLM, every query passes through a 9-stage pipeline:

steps.title: Protect privacy
steps.text: Finds and masks personal data such as names, emails and phone numbers.

steps.title: Understand intent
steps.text: Works out what the person is actually asking for.

steps.title: Pick out details
steps.text: Extracts key entities and filters from the question.

steps.title: Sharpen the question
steps.text: Rewrites short or vague questions using HyDE.

steps.title: Break it down
steps.text: Splits complex requests into focused sub-questions.

steps.title: Route smartly
steps.text: Ticket questions go to a SQL engine; document questions go to semantic and hybrid search over chunks split by document type — headers, pages and tables.

steps.title: Respect access
steps.text: Role-based access control (RBAC) filters results, so people only see what they're allowed to.

steps.title: Rank and answer
steps.text: Re-ranks the results and builds the context, and only then asks the LLM — with sources attached.

achievements.uniqueOutro: The result: a copilot that is privacy-aware, secure and reliable — not just a chatbot on top of a document store.
